Oriented with north toward the upper right. "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1874 by Matthew Hughes in the Office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington D.C." LC copy imperfect: Laminated, mounted on cloth backing, darkened along sheet edges, rubber-stamped at head of title.
